record.result: I added `TaskStore.paginate(offset=0, limit=10)` in `src/tasklib/store.py`. It returns a new list of the stored `Task` objects in creation order, completed ones included, sliced from `offset` to `offset + limit`. A zero `limit` or an `offset` past the end gives `[]`. It raises `ValueError` unless both arguments are nonnegative `int`s, so `bool` and other types are rejected. It only reads the store, so tasks, order and the next-ID counter are untouched. The visible tests pass (127 passed). I didn't add a test for `paginate`, since I can't edit test files.
